evidence.claim: 6-service source architecture, each service owns data, shared auth package; team directory supports point-in-time membership and scoped API keys
Shared provider-agnostic Bedrock LLM API plus threaded Discord helper with message history
Email ownership verification, one-time codes, attempt limits, TTLs and multi-email identity mapping
On-behalf-of user authorization and document visibility across user/team/org grants; content and metadata share access predicate
Live Discord voice to Transcribe to Bedrock minutes PDF; persistent per-speaker streams eliminate repeatedly re-transcribing accumulated audio; timestamps fixed and audio padding removed
Recovered transcripts/minutes after unexpected WebSocket disconnect through bounded grace window and bot finalization; linked to actual production incidents
Full document text/hash storage and six native source extractors: Docs, Slides, Sheets, Forms, PDF, DOCX
Security hardening for SSRF redirects, privilege escalation, verification replay, missing LLM scopes and credential redaction
Deployment runbooks and promotion process; corrected docs distinguish implemented source from provisioned service
